shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' app/product/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' lib/data.ts && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -print | sort && git status --short && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"The title should appear immediately|Navigating from home|Premium Widget|getInventory\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.git/**'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/instant-validation/instant-config.d.ts && sed -n '350,420p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && rg -n \"export const instant|instant =\" node_modules/next -g '*.js' -g '*.ts' | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json package.json package-lock.json && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/product-headers http://localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/product-response && sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/product-headers && rg -o \"Premium Widget|Loading inventory\\.\\.\\.|[0-9]+ in stock|Price: \\\\"'$[0-9.]+" /tmp/product-response | sed -n '"'1,20p' && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -bo 'Premium Widget|Loading inventory\\.\\.\\.|in stock|Price:' /tmp/product-response | sed -n '1,20p' && git diff --check"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && git diff -- tsconfig.json && test -d /workspace/.next && echo generated-build-output-present"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' .gitignore && git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed -n '1,120p' && git diff --stat && git diff --check"

/bin/bash -lc 'test -d /workspace/.next && find /workspace/.next -type f -delete && find /workspace/.next -depth -type d -empty -delete; git status --short; git diff --check; git diff -- app/product/page.tsx'
